annotations.title: SEC alerts pushed to your webhook (30 days)

description: Answers "Tell me the moment any of my holdings files something bad" without polling. One payment covers 30 days: every new alert matching your filters (a `tickers` watchlist, `levels`, `types`; default red, amber and green: restatements, delisting notices, bankruptcies, late 10-K/10-Q, auditor changes, cybersecurity incidents, impairments, changes in control, insider purchases of $100K+) is POSTed to your HTTPS `webhook_url` as JSON within about 2 minutes of being found, in the same shape sec_market_alerts returns, signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the `signing_secret` returned once at signup. Failed deliveries are retried every 2 minutes. The webhook must answer a test ping with 2xx or you are not charged. Extend with `renew_subscription_id` (+30 days); check deliveries or cancel with the free sec_alert_subscription_status. Subscriptions survive server restarts. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $1.00 USDC per 30 days via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

levels.description: Only these levels (red, amber, green, info). Default: red, amber and green.

renew_subscription_id.description: Extend this subscription by 30 days instead of creating one (its webhook and filters stay).

tickers.description: Watchlist: only alerts for these tickers. Default: the whole market.

types.description: Only these alert types: bankruptcy, restatement, delisting_notice, late_annual_report, auditor_change, cybersecurity_incident, impairment, debt_acceleration, change_in_control, late_quarterly_report, insider_purchase, leadership_change, earnings, material_agreement, acquisition_or_disposal, restructuring, unregistered_share_sale.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).

webhook_url.description: Your HTTPS endpoint. New alerts are POSTed to it as JSON, signed (see `verify`). It must answer a test ping with 2xx, or you are not charged.
